name: actionledger-ai
description: Durable action execution and conservative recovery for autonomous agents

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @actionledger/core build && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p apps/provider && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @actionledger/core build && pnpm --filter @actionledger/runtime build && pnpm --filter @actionledger/provider build && pnpm --filter @actionledger/server build && pnpm --filter @actionledger/web build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec prettier --check . && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.lint:python: uv run --frozen --offline --project examples/openai-agents-python ruff check examples/openai-agents-python && uv run --frozen --offline --project examples/openai-agents-python ruff format --check examples/openai-agents-python
scripts.test:python: uv run --frozen --offline --project examples/openai-agents-python python -m unittest discover -s examples/openai-agents-python/tests
